instruction.reason: Every stated requirement - API surface, scene composition, three beacons, timeline math, tour camera, focus, projection/picking, readouts, Step/Reset, getState, resize behavior - was delivered coherently across tested states, with no omissions observed.

interaction.reason: Click-to-focus, Step, Reset, boundary clamping and recovery sequences are reliable and natural; readouts update immediately and selecting another beacon clears prior highlight.

spatial.reason: Shapes, sizes, positions, ground contact, emissive highlight and camera framing consistently serve the task; depth, shadows and parallax are coherent in all views with no spatial errors found.

stability.reason: All standard and repeat checks were stable: repeated Step, repeated focus selections, reset, mobile/desktop resize, keyboard activation and reload, with zero console errors and all resources loading 200.

visual.reason: Composition, typography and color form a coherent, readable dark-stage expression; focus views are somewhat plain (large flat single-color cylinder filling frame, partially offscreen neighbors) and the small top-right hint is low-contrast, keeping it just below the top anchor.
